mapper.sql: SELECT tt.biz01_promo_id AS promo_id , COALESCE(tt.biz01_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS close_yn , tt.biz01_close_nm AS close_name , tt.biz01_html_card_nm AS html_card_name , tt.biz01_reg_emp_nm AS reg_emp_name , tt.biz01_approval_dt AS approval_dt , tt.biz01_franchise_nm AS franchise_name , tt.biz01_sector_nm AS sector_name , tt.biz01_provide_amt AS provide_amt , tt.biz01_provide_pur_cd AS provide_pur_code , tt.biz01_provide_pur_nm AS provide_pur_name , tt.biz01_provide_content_cd AS provide_content_code , tt.biz01_provide_content_nm AS provide_content_name , tt.biz01_account_code_id AS account_code_id , tt.biz01_account_cd AS account_code , tt.biz01_account_nm AS account_name , tt.biz01_tax_type AS tax_type , tt.biz01_tax_type_nm AS tax_type_name , tt.biz01_note AS note , tt.biz01_depn_book_yn AS depn_book_yn , tt.biz01_real_person_id AS real_person_id , tt.biz01_real_person_nm AS real_person_name

FROM ( SELECT t.* , f_cdnm('ProvidePurCode' , biz01_provide_pur_cd , biz01_company_id, biz01_provide_date) AS biz01_provide_pur_nm , f_cdnm('ProvideContentCode' , biz01_provide_content_cd , biz01_company_id, biz01_provide_date) AS biz01_provide_content_nm , f_cdnm('TaxType' , biz01_tax_type , biz01_company_id, biz01_provide_date) AS biz01_tax_type_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz01_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '마감' ELSE '' END AS biz01_close_nm , crd02_approval_dt AS biz01_approval_dt , crd02_franchise_nm AS biz01_franchise_nm , crd02_sector_nm AS biz01_sector_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM ast06_tr WHERE ast06_company_id = biz01_company_id AND ast06_card_approval_no = crd02_approval_no),0) = 0 THEN null ELSE '등록완료' END AS biz01_depn_book_yn , act01_account_cd AS biz01_account_cd , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END||act01_account_nm AS biz01_account_nm , crd01_card_nm AS biz01_html_card_nm , CASE WHEN sys01_card_real_user_yn = 'true' THEN CASE WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN '공통('||f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id)||')' WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NOT NULL THEN '공통('||f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_real_person_id)||')' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END END AS biz01_reg_emp_nm , CASE WHEN biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_real_person_id) END AS biz01_real_person_nm , crd02_approval_time AS biz01_approval_time FROM () t ) tt WHERE 1=1
AND CONCAT( biz01_franchise_nm , biz01_sector_nm , biz01_account_nm , biz01_html_card_nm , biz01_reg_emp_nm , biz01_provide_pur_nm , biz01_provide_content_nm) ILIKE '%'||#{searchText}||'%'

mapper.update: UPDATE biz01_promo SET biz01_close_yn = CASE WHEN #{procType} = 'P' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_std_ym = #{dataYm} AND biz01_card_id IN ( SELECT crd01_card_id FROM crd01_card WHERE crd01_card_id = biz01_card_id )
mapper.select: WITH CardCounts AS ( SELECT crd02_card_no , COUNT(*) as count FROM ( SELECT * , biz01_provide_amt AS crd02_provide_amt FROM ( SELECT * FROM crd02_data INNER JOIN biz01_promo ON crd02_data_id = biz01_card_data_id WHERE biz01_std_ym = #{dataYm} AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_provide_amt != crd02_approval_amount UNION ALL SELECT * FROM crd02_data LEFT OUTER JOIN biz01_promo ON biz01_card_data_id = crd02_data_id WHERE crd02_data_ym = #{dataYm} AND crd02_company_id = #{companyId} AND crd02_data_id NOT IN (SELECT biz01_card_data_id FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_std_ym = #{dataYm} AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId}) ) t ) subquery GROUP BY crd02_card_no ) SELECT s.crd02_card_no AS card_no , s.crd02_approval_dt AS approval_dt , s.crd02_franchise_nm AS franchise_name , s.crd02_sector_nm AS sector_name , s.crd02_approval_amount AS approval_amount , s.crd02_provide_amt AS provide_amt FROM ( SELECT * , biz01_provide_amt AS crd02_provide_amt FROM ( SELECT * FROM crd02_data INNER JOIN biz01_promo ON crd02_data_id = biz01_card_data_id WHERE biz01_std_ym = #{dataYm} AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_provide_amt != crd02_approval_amount UNION ALL SELECT * FROM crd02_data LEFT OUTER JOIN biz01_promo ON biz01_card_data_id = crd02_data_id WHERE crd02_data_ym = #{dataYm} AND crd02_company_id = #{companyId} AND crd02_data_id NOT IN (SELECT biz01_card_data_id FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_std_ym = #{dataYm} AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId}) ) t ) s JOIN CardCounts c ON s.crd02_card_no = c.crd02_card_no WHERE c.count = 1
